categories_symptomes.guide: Each STI: signs, testing and patterns
intro: STIs are passed on during sex (vaginal, anal or oral), and sometimes through blood or from mother to baby. Many cause no symptoms at all: only a test can tell you.

Where to get tested: at a sexual health clinic (free CeGIDD centers in France), anonymously if you like, with your doctor, a midwife or at a sexual health center. At a lab, without a prescription (in France: “Mon test IST”): the HIV test is free for everyone, and tests for chlamydia, gonorrhea, syphilis and hepatitis B are also free if you are under 26.
Condoms protect against most STIs. Vaccines exist against hepatitis B, hepatitis A, papillomavirus (HPV) and mpox.
Chinese medicine does not cure an STI. The patterns shown support your body's underlying balance and your comfort (itching, burning, fatigue), always alongside medical treatment.
For any question about STIs, call a helpline (in France: Sida Info Service, 0 800 840 800, free and anonymous, 7 days a week from 8 a.m. to 11 p.m.).
precautions: Sex without a condom, or a condom that broke: go to the emergency room right away (or to a sexual health clinic (free CeGIDD centers in France) during the day) to assess the risk of HIV; emergency treatment (PEP) works best within 4 hours and must be started within 48 hours at the latest. If there is a risk of pregnancy, get emergency contraception at a pharmacy (free and without a prescription in France). Then get tested for STIs.
During an infection, avoid sex until your treatment is finished, and tell your partners so they can get tested.
Don't massage an area with a sore, blisters or warts, and wash your hands after touching it.
rappel: Don't massage an area with a sore, blisters or warts, and wash your hands after touching it.

categories_symptomes.note: Your medical treatment remains the foundation. The patterns show the underlying imbalance often seen with these diagnoses, to support that treatment.
categories_symptomes.guide: Each condition: key facts and patterns
intro: These conditions are diagnosed by a doctor, with a blood test or another lab test. Keep your treatment and your follow-up: the routines in this app support them, they never replace them.
In Chinese medicine, the same condition can match several patterns depending on the person: also choose your other symptoms to find the one that fits you best.
Hashimoto's or Graves' disease: no iodine supplements and no seaweed (kelp, bladderwrack) without medical advice.

categories_symptomes.note: Rheumatoid arthritis is treated by a rheumatologist, as early as possible. The patterns help with pain, stiffness and fatigue, alongside treatment.
categories_symptomes.guide: Rheumatoid arthritis: key facts and patterns
intro: Rheumatoid arthritis is the most common inflammatory rheumatic disease. It mostly affects women, often between the ages of 40 and 60.
The earlier disease-modifying treatment starts, the better your joints are protected. Physical therapy, occupational therapy and gentle physical activity help a lot.

Chinese medicine looks at the phase you are in: during a flare (heat, swelling), you cool and drain; when things are calm, you warm, get things moving and nourish the Liver and Kidney. Also choose your current signs to find the right pattern.
Patient association (in France: AFPric, Association française des polyarthritiques et des rhumatismes inflammatoires chroniques).
precautions: Flare (red, hot, swollen joints): no heat and no moxa on the joint, only gentle pressure around it.
On methotrexate or a biologic: if you get a fever, a cough or an infection, see a doctor quickly; no herbs and no supplements without your rheumatologist's advice.
A very hot, very painful joint with fever: see a doctor the same day.

categories_symptomes.note: Multiple sclerosis is treated by a neurologist. The patterns show the underlying imbalance often seen with it, to help with fatigue, walking, sleep and mood, alongside treatment.
intro: Multiple sclerosis (MS) is a disease of the central nervous system: the immune system damages the sheath around the nerves of the brain and spinal cord. It often begins between the ages of 20 and 40, and more often in women.
Disease-modifying treatments, physical therapy and adapted physical activity are the foundation. The routines in this app can help with fatigue, sleep, digestion and mood.
Patient association (in France: Ligue française contre la sclérose en plaques).
precautions: A new problem (vision, strength, sensation, balance) lasting more than 24 hours: tell your neurologist, it may be a relapse.
Sudden weakness on one side, trouble speaking, loss of vision: call emergency services (15 or 112 in France).
No prolonged heat if it makes your symptoms worse; never a hot-water bottle or moxa on an area with reduced sensation.
No herbs and no supplements without your neurologist's advice.

categories_symptomes.note: Chinese medicine does not cure cancer. It can help you cope better with treatment (fatigue, nausea, sleep, digestion, mood), always with your care team's agreement.
categories_symptomes.guide: Each cancer: treatment side effects and patterns
intro: Cancer is treated with surgery, chemotherapy, radiation therapy, hormone therapy, immunotherapy or targeted therapies. Nothing here replaces or delays these treatments.
In Chinese medicine, there is no single “cancer pattern”: we look at the person's underlying balance and at the side effects of treatment. That is what the matches below show.

What often helps, for your comfort and alongside your prescribed medicines: gentle self-massage of PC 6 (on the wrist) for nausea and of ST 36 (below the knee) for fatigue, warm, cooked meals that are easy to digest, rest, and gentle activity such as walking or qi gong.

Supportive care exists and is often free: psychologist, dietitian, adapted physical activity, beauty and wellbeing care. Ask your care team. (In France: Cancer info, 0 805 123 124, free service and call.)
precautions: Tell your oncologist about any herb, herbal tea, supplement or mushroom you take: some change how treatments work (St John's wort, grapefruit, Chinese angelica or dang gui, astragalus, high doses of turmeric or ginseng…).

During and after treatment, use only gentle pressure (tonification), never strong pressure. Skip any point on the tumor, on an area that has been operated on or irradiated, on a stoma, near an implanted port, on the belly after pelvic radiation therapy, or on a swollen arm or leg (lymphedema).
No moxa or hot-water bottle on an irradiated area or an area with reduced sensation, and no moxa (flame, smoke) if you are short of breath or use oxygen at home.
Low white blood cells: avoid raw foods (oysters and shellfish, raw fish, undercooked eggs, raw milk). Low platelets: very gentle pressure only; stop if you bruise.
Fever of 38 °C (100.4 °F) or higher during chemotherapy: call your care team right away, or emergency services (15 or 112 in France).
rappel: Gentle pressure only, never strong. Skip points on an area that has been operated on or irradiated, a stoma, the belly after pelvic radiation therapy, or a swollen arm or leg.
No moxa on an irradiated area or an area with reduced sensation, and none if you are short of breath or on oxygen.

Recipes: ask your care team before using Chinese angelica (dang gui), astragalus, ginseng or large amounts of turmeric. Low white blood cells: nothing raw (oysters, shellfish, raw fish, undercooked eggs).
Fever of 38 °C (100.4 °F) or higher during chemotherapy: call your care team or emergency services (15 or 112 in France).

At the end of the session, for massage. Moves Qi and Blood, calms pain.
On days without moxa, rubbed into the knee. Warming.
A neutral base for massaging longer, or for diluting an essential oil.
Only as an extra, always diluted: 2 to 3 drops in a teaspoon of oil. Never with moxa. Avoid if you take blood thinners or are allergic to aspirin.

fiches.regle: Never put heat on a product you have just applied: moxa first, product after.

fiches.titre: Scrambled eggs with shrimp and Chinese chives
fiches.contexte: Chinese chives are nicknamed “the herb that lifts Yang”; together with shrimp, they warm the Kidney. A quick dish for a cold lower back, fatigue with a sense of cold, and low libido.

ingredients.nom: Chinese chives (jiu cai), cut into 3 cm (1 in) lengths

variantes.nom: In a frying pan or wok

etapes.texte: Beat the eggs ({oeufs}) with half the salt ({sel}).
Heat half the oil ({huile}) until very hot, pour in the eggs and stir gently until they set but are still soft. Set aside.
Add the rest of the oil, the ginger ({gingembre}), then the shrimp ({crevettes}). Stir-fry them until they turn pink.
Add the Chinese chives ({ciboule}) and the rest of the salt, and stir-fry over high heat just until they wilt.
Return the eggs to the pan, give it one last stir and serve right away with rice.

fiches.precautions: A warming dish: avoid it if you have signs of Heat (red tongue, thirst, pimples, fever) or a seafood allergy.
notes: You'll find Chinese chives in bunches in Asian grocery stores: flat leaves, with a taste somewhere between garlic and chives. If you can't find them, use very thinly sliced leek or regular chives.

fiches.titre: Fox nut, lotus seed and Chinese yam congee
fiches.contexte: Fox nuts and lotus seeds “tighten”: they help the Kidney hold in what is leaking out (seminal emissions, urine leaks, soft stools). Chinese yam supports the Spleen and Kidney. A mild, nourishing bowl that also calms the mind.

ingredients.nom: dried fox nuts (euryale seeds, qian shi)
fresh Chinese yam (shan yao), diced (or 30 g dried)

etapes.texte: Soak the fox nuts ({qianshi}) and lotus seeds ({lotus}) in cold water, then drain.
Bring the water ({eau}) to a boil with the fox nuts and lotus seeds, then let it simmer, covered.
Add the rinsed rice ({riz}), yam ({shanyao}) and jujubes ({dattes}). Let it simmer with the lid slightly ajar, stirring from time to time, until it turns thick and creamy.
Serve hot. Thin it with a little hot water if the congee has gotten too thick.

variantes.nom: In a rice cooker or multicooker

etapes.texte: Soak the fox nuts ({qianshi}) and lotus seeds ({lotus}) in cold water, then drain.

etapes.titre: Put everything in the inner pot
etapes.texte: Put the rinsed rice ({riz}), fox nuts, lotus seeds, yam ({shanyao}), jujubes ({dattes}) and water ({eau}) in the inner pot.
Start the Porridge or Congee program.
Stir and serve hot.

fiches.precautions: A dish that “tightens”: avoid it if you have dry constipation or a swollen, painful belly.
notes: Fox nuts (small white and red balls) and lotus seeds are sold dried in Asian grocery stores.
You can make a big batch: it keeps for 3 days in the fridge.

fiches.titre: Braised chicken with chestnuts and shiitake mushrooms
fiches.contexte: Chestnut is nicknamed the “Kidney fruit”: it strengthens the lower back and knees. With chicken and ginger, it makes a fall dish that warms the Spleen and Kidney.

principe.fr: Tonify the Kidney, strengthen the Spleen

ingredients.nom: dried shiitake mushrooms, soaked for 30 min
water (including the strained shiitake soaking water)

variantes.nom: In a cast-iron casserole pot or saucepan

etapes.texte: Brown the chicken ({poulet}) in the oil ({huile}) with the ginger ({gingembre}) and the white parts of the spring onions ({cebette}).
Add the shiitakes ({shiitake}) cut in half, the soy sauce ({soja}) and the water ({eau}). Cover and let it simmer gently.
Add the chestnuts ({chataignes}) and keep cooking uncovered to reduce the sauce.
Sprinkle with the green parts of the spring onions and serve with rice.
On the Sauté setting, if your cooker has one, brown the chicken ({poulet}) in the oil ({huile}) with the ginger ({gingembre}) and the white parts of the spring onions ({cebette}).
Add the shiitakes ({shiitake}), chestnuts ({chataignes}), soy sauce ({soja}) and water ({eau}). Simmer or Stew program.
Sprinkle with the green parts of the spring onions and serve with rice.
Brown the chicken ({poulet}) in the oil ({huile}) with the ginger ({gingembre}) and the white parts of the spring onions ({cebette}).
Add the shiitakes ({shiitake}), soy sauce ({soja}) and water ({eau}). Close the lid and start timing once it starts to hiss.
Let the pressure drop, add the chestnuts ({chataignes}) and let the sauce reduce uncovered.
Sprinkle with the green parts of the spring onions and serve with rice.

notes: With fresh chestnuts: cut a slit in each one, boil them for 15 minutes and peel them while they're still hot.

fiches.titre: Braised lamb with fennel and fennel seeds
fiches.contexte: Fennel seeds warm the Liver meridian and the lower belly; lamb and ginger warm the Kidney and Spleen. For cold-type pain in the lower belly, periods that come with a feeling of cold, and icy hands and feet.

ingredients.nom: lamb shoulder or neck, cut into pieces

etapes.texte: Brown the lamb ({agneau}) in the oil ({huile}) on all sides.
Add the ginger ({gingembre}), garlic ({ail}) and fennel seeds ({graines}), and stir until fragrant.
Pour in the water ({eau}), add salt ({sel}), cover and let it simmer very gently.
Add the fennel ({fenouil}) and carrots ({carotte}), and keep cooking until everything is meltingly tender.
Serve hot, with rice or millet.
On the Sauté setting, if your cooker has one, brown the lamb ({agneau}) in the oil ({huile}) with the ginger ({gingembre}), garlic ({ail}) and fennel seeds ({graines}).
Add the fennel ({fenouil}), carrots ({carotte}), water ({eau}) and salt ({sel}). Simmer or Stew program.
Serve hot, with rice or millet.
Brown the lamb ({agneau}) in the oil ({huile}) with the ginger ({gingembre}), garlic ({ail}) and fennel seeds ({graines}).
Add the fennel ({fenouil}), carrots ({carotte}), water ({eau}) and salt ({sel}). Close the lid and start timing once it starts to hiss.
Let the pressure drop on its own and serve.

fiches.precautions: A very warming dish: not if you have a fever, a red tongue, intense thirst or hot flashes.
notes: Mutton works too; cook it half an hour longer.

fiches.titre: Duck soup with Chinese yam and goji berries
fiches.contexte: Duck nourishes Yin without weighing you down; Chinese yam supports the Spleen, Lung and Kidney, and goji nourishes the Liver and Kidney. For a dry mouth, night sweats, and feeling hot late in the day.

ingredients.nom: fresh Chinese yam (shan yao), cut into chunks (or 40 g dried)

etapes.texte: Drop the duck ({canard}) into boiling water, then drain and rinse: the broth will be clearer and less fatty.
Put the duck back in the cold water ({eau}) with the ginger ({gingembre}) and the white parts of the spring onions ({cebette}). Bring to a simmer and cook covered, skimming off the foam at the start.
Add the yam ({shanyao}) and keep cooking.
Add the goji berries ({goji}) and salt ({sel}).
Skim off the fat if needed and serve with the green parts of the spring onions.
Drop the duck ({canard}) into boiling water, then drain and rinse.
Put the duck, yam ({shanyao}), ginger ({gingembre}), spring onion whites ({cebette}) and water ({eau}) in the inner pot. Soup program.
Add the goji ({goji}) and salt ({sel}), and leave it on Keep Warm.
Skim off the fat if needed and serve.
Drop the duck ({canard}) into boiling water, then drain and rinse.
Put in the duck, yam ({shanyao}), ginger ({gingembre}), spring onion whites ({cebette}) and water ({eau}). Close the lid and start timing once it starts to hiss.
Let the pressure drop, add the goji ({goji}) and salt ({sel}) and let it simmer.
Skim off the fat if needed and serve.

fiches.precautions: Duck is cooling: if you often feel cold or have soft stools, double the ginger.
notes: Once the broth has cooled, it's easy to skim: the fat sets on the surface.

fiches.titre: Pan-fried chicken livers with spinach and goji
fiches.contexte: In Chinese dietary therapy, liver nourishes the Liver: chicken livers, spinach and goji nourish the Blood. For tired eyes, floaters, cramps and brittle nails.

principe.fr: Nourish the Liver, tonify the Blood

etapes.texte: Heat half the oil ({huile}) until very hot and sear the livers ({foies}) with the ginger ({gingembre}): they should stay pink in the middle. Set aside.
In the rest of the oil, fry the garlic ({ail}), then the spinach ({epinards}) until it wilts.
Return the livers to the pan, add the goji ({goji}) and soy sauce ({soja}), and stir over the heat.
Serve right away, with rice.

fiches.precautions: Rich in vitamin A: if you're pregnant, limit organ meats to a small portion now and then, and ask your midwife or doctor for advice.
notes: Overcooked livers turn dry and bitter: take them off the heat as soon as they're browned.

fiches.titre: Cucumber, tofu and wakame broth
fiches.contexte: Cucumber, tofu and seaweed are cooling and drain Dampness through the urine. A light broth for dark urine, intimate itching, a bitter taste in the mouth, and hot weather.

etapes.texte: Soak the wakame ({wakame}) in cold water, then drain.
Bring the water ({eau}) to a simmer with the ginger ({gingembre}) and soy sauce ({soja}).
Add the tofu ({tofu}), cucumber ({concombre}) and wakame, and let it simmer.
Sprinkle with spring onion ({cebette}) and serve warm.

fiches.precautions: A cooling dish: if you often feel cold or have soft stools, save it for hot weather and add ginger.
notes: You'll find dried wakame in Asian grocery stores or the organic aisle; it swells a lot.

fiches.titre: Stir-fried wood ear mushrooms with celery, garlic and ginger
fiches.contexte: Wood ear mushrooms (mu er) gently get the Blood moving; celery calms Liver Yang. A side dish for fixed pain, periods with clots, high blood pressure and throbbing temples.

principe.fr: Get the Blood moving, clear the vessels

ingredients.nom: celery stalks, sliced on the diagonal

variantes.nom: In a frying pan or wok

etapes.texte: Soak the wood ear mushrooms ({muer}) in lukewarm water, then rinse them and cut off the hard parts.
Fry the garlic ({ail}) and ginger ({gingembre}) in the hot oil ({huile}).
Add the carrot ({carotte}), celery ({celeri}) and mushrooms, and stir-fry over high heat.
Add the soy sauce ({soja}), stir and serve right away.

fiches.precautions: Wood ear mushrooms thin the blood: if you take a blood thinner, are pregnant, or have surgery coming up, ask for advice.
notes: You'll find them dried in Asian grocery stores; 15 g dried makes a big bowlful once they've swollen.

fiches.titre: Spring onion and ginger congee
fiches.contexte: A classic kitchen remedy at the very start of a chill-type cold: chills, clear runny nose, stiff neck. Spring onion whites and ginger make you sweat a little, and the rice protects the Stomach.

ingredients.nom: spring onion whites, with their roots, washed

etapes.texte: Bring the water ({eau}) to a boil with the rinsed rice ({riz}), then let it simmer with the lid slightly ajar.
Add the ginger ({gingembre}) and the spring onion whites ({cebette}), crushed with the flat of a knife. Let it simmer a little longer.
Add salt ({sel}) and have it piping hot, then bundle up so you sweat a little.

variantes.nom: In a rice cooker or multicooker

etapes.texte: Put the rinsed rice ({riz}) and water ({eau}) in the inner pot and start the Porridge or Congee program.
Add the ginger ({gingembre}) and the crushed spring onion whites ({cebette}), close the lid and leave on Keep Warm.
Add salt ({sel}) and have it piping hot, then bundle up.

fiches.precautions: Only at the very start of a chill-type cold. If there's a sore throat, a high fever or yellow phlegm, it's no longer the right time.
notes: The aromatics only cook for a few minutes: that's what keeps them effective.

fiches.titre: Beef bone broth with carrots and ginger
fiches.contexte: A long-simmered broth that supports the Kidney, bones and tendons. For tired knees and lower back, recovery after illness, and long winters.

principe.fr: Tonify the Kidney, strengthen the bones

etapes.texte: Cover the bones ({os}) with cold water, bring to a boil, then drain and rinse: the broth will be clearer.
Put the bones back in the cold water ({eau}) with the vinegar ({vinaigre}), ginger ({gingembre}), onion ({oignon}) and star anise ({anis}). Let it barely simmer, covered.
Add the carrots ({carotte}) and jujubes ({dattes}) and keep cooking.
Strain, add salt ({sel}) and serve a hot bowlful. Save the marrow and the shank meat for another meal.
Cover the bones ({os}) with cold water, bring to a boil, then drain and rinse.

Put in the bones, the water ({eau}) up to the inner pot's limit, the vinegar ({vinaigre}), ginger ({gingembre}), onion ({oignon}), star anise ({anis}), carrots ({carotte}) and jujubes ({dattes}). Slow Cook or Long Soup program.
Strain, add salt ({sel}) and serve.
Cover the bones ({os}) with cold water, bring to a boil, then drain and rinse.

Put the bones back in with the water ({eau}) up to the max line, the vinegar ({vinaigre}), ginger ({gingembre}), onion ({oignon}) and star anise ({anis}). Close the lid and start timing once it starts to hiss.
Let the pressure drop, add the carrots ({carotte}) and jujubes ({dattes}) and let it simmer uncovered.
Strain, add salt ({sel}) and serve.

notes: It keeps for 4 days in the fridge and freezes very well in portions.
Once cooled, it sets into a jelly: that's a good sign.

fiches.titre: Warm oysters with ginger and spring onion
fiches.contexte: Oyster nourishes Yin and Essence and calms the mind; its shell is a classic remedy for holding in Essence and calming. Barely cooked, with ginger to balance their cooling nature.

ingredients.nom: fresh ginger, cut into fine julienne

etapes.texte: Set the oysters ({huitres}) cupped side down in a steamer basket over boiling water and cover: they'll open slightly.
Remove the flat top shell of each oyster with a knife, keeping the juice.
Top each one with a little ginger ({gingembre}), spring onion ({cebette}), a drop of soy sauce ({soja}) and sesame oil ({huile}). Serve warm.
Preheat the oven on the broil setting to 220 °C (425 °F).
Set the oysters ({huitres}) cupped side down on a baking sheet, propped up with crumpled foil, and put them in the oven: they'll open slightly.
Open them, then top each one with a little ginger ({gingembre}), spring onion ({cebette}), a drop of soy sauce ({soja}) and sesame oil ({huile}).

fiches.precautions: Throw away any that stay closed after cooking. Not if you have a seafood allergy.
notes: Out of season, frozen shucked oysters can be pan-fried for 1 minute with the ginger.

fiches.titre: Black sesame and walnut cream
fiches.contexte: A great classic for the Kidney and Essence: graying or thinning hair, failing memory, dry constipation, tired lower back. Drink it warm at breakfast or as an afternoon snack.

variantes.nom: In a saucepan, with a blender

etapes.texte: Dry-toast the sesame ({sesame}), walnuts ({noix}) and rice ({riz}) in a frying pan, stirring constantly, until fragrant.
Blend everything until smooth with the jujubes ({dattes}) and half the water ({eau}).
Pour into a saucepan with the rest of the water and let it thicken over low heat, stirring.
Serve warm and plain: the jujubes are enough to sweeten it.
Dry-toast the sesame ({sesame}), walnuts ({noix}) and rice ({riz}) in a frying pan until fragrant.
Put everything in the blender with the jujubes ({dattes}) and water ({eau}), and start the Smooth Soup or Plant Milk program.
Serve warm.

fiches.precautions: Rich and fatty: if you have soft stools or diarrhea, wait until it passes.
notes: Extra toasted sesame keeps for 2 weeks in a closed jar.

fiches.titre: Braised beef with carrots, jujubes and ginger
fiches.contexte: Beef tonifies Qi and Blood and strengthens the Spleen, tendons and bones; the jujubes and carrot round it out. A deeply nourishing dish for fatigue and recovery after illness.

ingredients.nom: stewing beef (chuck, cheek or shoulder), cubed

variantes.nom: In a cast-iron casserole pot or saucepan

etapes.texte: Brown the beef ({boeuf}) in the oil ({huile}) on all sides.
Add the onion ({oignon}) and ginger ({gingembre}), and stir until fragrant.
Pour in the water ({eau}) and soy sauce ({soja}), then add the star anise ({anis}) and jujubes ({dattes}). Cover and let it simmer very gently.
Add the carrots ({carotte}) and keep cooking until the meat is meltingly tender.
Remove the star anise, taste and serve with rice.
On the Sauté setting, if your cooker has one, brown the beef ({boeuf}) in the oil ({huile}), then the onion ({oignon}) and ginger ({gingembre}).
Add the water ({eau}), soy sauce ({soja}), star anise ({anis}), jujubes ({dattes}) and carrots ({carotte}). Simmer or Stew program.
Remove the star anise and serve with rice.
Brown the beef ({boeuf}) in the oil ({huile}) right in the pressure cooker, then the onion ({oignon}) and ginger ({gingembre}).
Add the water ({eau}), soy sauce ({soja}), star anise ({anis}), jujubes ({dattes}) and carrots ({carotte}). Close the lid and start timing once it starts to hiss.
Let the pressure drop on its own, remove the star anise and serve.

notes: A gelatinous cut (cheek, chuck) makes a more nourishing sauce.

fiches.titre: Stir-fried beef with broccoli and ginger
fiches.contexte: Quick and nourishing: beef tonifies Qi and Blood, and well-cooked broccoli stays easy to digest.

ingredients.nom: quick-cooking beef (sirloin, flank steak), cut into thin strips
slices of ginger, cut into matchsticks
cornstarch, mixed with 3 spoonfuls of water

variantes.nom: In a frying pan or wok

etapes.texte: Drop the broccoli ({brocoli}) into boiling water, then drain it.
Heat the oil ({huile}) over very high heat and sear the beef ({boeuf}) just until it changes color. Set it aside.
Fry the garlic ({ail}) and ginger ({gingembre}) for a few seconds, then add the broccoli and stir-fry.
Return the beef to the pan, add the soy sauce ({soja}) and the cornstarch mixture ({fecule}), and stir until the sauce coats everything. Serve with rice.

notes: Slice the beef while it's half-frozen: you'll get thinner strips.

fiches.titre: Mutton and daikon soup
fiches.contexte: A winter classic in China: mutton warms Spleen and Kidney Yang, and daikon lightens the dish and helps you digest the meat.
fiches.precautions: Avoid it if you have signs of heat: red tongue, thirst, night sweats, red pimples.

ingredients.nom: mutton or lamb (shoulder, neck), cut into pieces
daikon (white radish), cut into large chunks
stalks of spring onion, finely sliced

etapes.texte: Drop the mutton ({mouton}) into boiling water, then rinse it: the broth will be clearer and less gamy.
Put the meat, ginger ({gingembre}) and water ({eau}) in a large pot. Bring to a boil, skim off the foam and let it simmer, covered.
Add the daikon ({radis}) and carrot ({carotte}). Keep cooking until the daikon turns translucent.
Season with salt and pepper ({sel}) and sprinkle with spring onion ({cebette}).
Drop the mutton ({mouton}) into boiling water, then rinse it.
Put the meat, ginger ({gingembre}), daikon ({radis}), carrot ({carotte}) and water ({eau}) in the inner pot. Soup or Simmer program.
Season with salt and pepper ({sel}) and sprinkle with spring onion ({cebette}).
Drop the mutton ({mouton}) into boiling water, then rinse it.
Put the meat, ginger ({gingembre}) and water ({eau}) in the pressure cooker. Start timing once it starts to hiss.
Open it once the pressure has dropped, add the daikon ({radis}) and carrot ({carotte}), and let it simmer with the lid off.
Season with salt and pepper ({sel}) and sprinkle with spring onion ({cebette}).

notes: Serve the broth piping hot first, then the meat and daikon.

fiches.titre: Chicken and ginger congee
fiches.contexte: The recovery congee: chicken tonifies Qi and gently warms the center, and ginger aids digestion.

ingredients.nom: boneless chicken breast or thigh, cut into thin strips
slices of ginger, cut into thin matchsticks
stalks of spring onion, finely sliced

etapes.texte: Rinse the rice ({riz}) and bring it to a boil in the water ({eau}) with half the ginger ({gingembre}). Let it simmer with the lid ajar, stirring.
Add the chicken ({poulet}) and the rest of the ginger, stir and let it cook gently.
Add salt ({sel}), then sprinkle with spring onion ({cebette}) and a few drops of sesame oil ({sesame}).

variantes.nom: In a rice cooker or multicooker

etapes.texte: Put the rinsed rice ({riz}) and half the ginger ({gingembre}) in the inner pot, with water up to the Porridge line. Porridge or Congee program.
Add the chicken ({poulet}) and the rest of the ginger, stir, and leave on Keep Warm or run a short cycle, until the chicken is cooked through.
Add salt ({sel}), sprinkle with spring onion ({cebette}) and add a drizzle of sesame oil ({sesame}).

notes: Make sure the chicken is cooked through, with no pink in the middle.

fiches.titre: Stir-fried chicken with shiitake mushrooms and ginger
fiches.contexte: Shiitake strengthens Spleen Qi and your defenses, and chicken tonifies Qi: an everyday dish for fatigue and slow digestion.

ingredients.nom: chicken breast or thigh, cut into strips
fresh shiitake mushrooms, sliced (or 8 dried, soaked for 30 min)
slices of ginger, cut into matchsticks

variantes.nom: In a frying pan or wok

etapes.texte: Brown the chicken ({poulet}) in the oil ({huile}) until cooked through.
Add the garlic ({ail}), ginger ({gingembre}) and shiitakes ({shiitake}), and stir-fry until tender.
Add the soy sauce ({soja}) and spring onion ({cebette}), stir and serve with rice.

notes: Save the soaking water from dried shiitakes for a soup.

fiches.titre: Oyster soup with tofu and ginger
fiches.contexte: Oyster meat nourishes Yin and Blood and calms the mind; tofu is gently cooling. For restless sleep, night sweats, and fatigue with dryness.
fiches.precautions: Cook the oysters thoroughly. Avoid them if you have a seafood allergy, and don't eat them raw during pregnancy.

ingredients.nom: oysters, shucked, with their liquid strained
slices of ginger, cut into thin matchsticks
stalk of spring onion, finely sliced

etapes.texte: Bring the water ({eau}) to a simmer with the ginger ({gingembre}).
Gently add the tofu ({tofu}).
Add the oysters ({huitres}) and their strained liquid. Take the pan off the heat as soon as their edges curl.
Add pepper ({poivre}) and sprinkle with spring onion ({cebette}). Taste before adding salt: the oyster liquid is already salty.

notes: Frozen shucked oysters from Asian grocery stores work too.

fiches.titre: Braised octopus with potatoes and garlic
fiches.contexte: Octopus nourishes Qi and Blood; cooked for a long time, it turns tender and easy to digest. Potatoes support the Spleen.
fiches.precautions: Avoid it if you have a seafood allergy.

ingredients.nom: cleaned octopus (it's more tender if frozen, then thawed)

etapes.texte: Drop the octopus ({poulpe}) into a large pot of boiling water with the bay leaf ({laurier}) and ginger ({gingembre}). Let it simmer, covered, until the tip of a knife goes in easily.
Drain the octopus and cut it into pieces.
Gently fry the onion ({oignon}) and garlic ({ail}) in the oil ({huile}).
Add the potatoes ({pdt}), octopus and water ({eau}). Let it simmer, covered, until the potatoes are tender.
Season with salt and pepper ({sel}).
Put the octopus ({poulpe}), bay leaf ({laurier}) and ginger ({gingembre}) in the pressure cooker and add water to come halfway up. Start timing once it starts to hiss.
Let the pressure drop, drain the octopus and cut it into pieces.
In the emptied pressure cooker, gently fry the onion ({oignon}) and garlic ({ail}) in the oil ({huile}).
Add the potatoes ({pdt}), octopus and water ({eau}), and close the lid again.
Season with salt and pepper ({sel}).

fiches.titre: Stir-fried squid with celery and ginger
fiches.contexte: Squid nourishes Yin and Blood, and celery cools the Liver: a light dish when heat rises to your head and your eyes are dry.
fiches.precautions: Avoid it if you have a seafood allergy.

ingredients.nom: celery stalks, sliced on the diagonal
slices of ginger, cut into matchsticks

variantes.nom: In a frying pan or wok

etapes.texte: In a very hot pan, sear the squid ({calamar}) in the oil ({huile}) just until it turns white, then set it aside. Overcooked squid gets tough.
Fry the garlic ({ail}) and ginger ({gingembre}), then the celery ({celeri}): it should stay crunchy.
Return the squid to the pan for 30 seconds with the soy sauce ({soja}) and spring onion ({cebette}). Serve with rice.

fiches.titre: Steamed white fish with ginger and spring onion
fiches.contexte: Steaming keeps fish light and easy to digest; ginger and spring onion warm the Stomach. Ideal for a delicate digestion or nausea.

principe.fr: Strengthen the Spleen, harmonize the Stomach

ingredients.nom: white fish fillets (cod, sea bass, sea bream…)
slices of ginger, cut into thin matchsticks
stalks of spring onion, cut into thin strips

etapes.texte: Lay the fillets ({poisson}) on a deep plate and scatter half the ginger ({gingembre}) over them.
Set the plate over a pot of simmering water, with the lid on, until the flesh turns opaque.
Pour over the soy sauce ({soja}), then add the rest of the ginger and the spring onion ({cebette}). Drizzle with sizzling-hot oil ({huile}) to bring out the aromas.
Lay the fillets ({poisson}) on a plate that fits in the basket, with half the ginger ({gingembre}).
Put water in the inner pot as the manual says, then use the Steam program. You can cook rice underneath at the same time.
Add the soy sauce ({soja}), the rest of the ginger and the spring onion ({cebette}), then the sizzling-hot oil ({huile}).

notes: A whole fish (sea bass, sea bream) is made the same way: allow a few more minutes.

fiches.titre: Fish soup with adzuki beans
fiches.contexte: A classic recipe for swelling: fish supports the Spleen, and adzuki beans drain water through the urine. In China, it's made with carp.
fiches.precautions: Swelling (edema) should also be checked by a doctor.

ingredients.nom: carp steaks or firm white fish
ingredients.note: You'll find carp in Asian grocery stores or at the fish counter.

ingredients.nom: dried tangerine peel (or the zest of an organic tangerine)

etapes.texte: Drain the adzuki beans ({azuki}), put them in the water ({eau}) with the peel ({mandarine}), bring to a boil and let it simmer.
Add the fish ({poisson}) and ginger ({gingembre}), and let it simmer gently without stirring.
Add very little salt ({sel}): salt makes the body hold on to water. Drink the broth and eat the beans.
Put the drained adzuki beans ({azuki}), peel ({mandarine}) and water ({eau}) in the inner pot. Soup or Simmer program.
Add the fish ({poisson}) and ginger ({gingembre}), and run a short cycle.
Add very little salt ({sel}).

notes: Watch out for carp bones: serve it in large pieces that are easy to pick through.

fiches.titre: Baked salmon with sweet potato and ginger
fiches.contexte: Salmon tonifies Qi and nourishes the Blood, and sweet potato strengthens the Spleen. A simple, complete meal, baked or steamed.

ingredients.nom: stalk of spring onion, finely sliced

etapes.texte: Preheat the oven to 200 °C (400 °F). Toss the sweet potato ({patate}) with the oil ({huile}) and salt ({sel}), spread it on a baking sheet and put it in the oven.
Mix the ginger ({gingembre}) and soy sauce ({soja}), and brush it over the fillets ({saumon}).
Place the salmon on the baking sheet next to the sweet potato and bake until just cooked.
Sprinkle with spring onion ({cebette}).
Steam the sweet potato ({patate}) until tender.
Brush the fillets ({saumon}) with the ginger ({gingembre}) and soy sauce ({soja}), and add them to the steamer basket.
Drizzle with a little oil ({huile}) and sprinkle with spring onion ({cebette}).

fiches.titre: Mussels with ginger and spring onion
fiches.contexte: Mussels, slightly warming by nature, nourish the Liver and Kidney, Essence and Blood: for a weak lower back, dizziness and deep-seated fatigue.

principe.py: Bǔ gān shèn yì jīng xuè
principe.fr: Tonify the Liver and Kidney, nourish Essence and Blood

fiches.precautions: Avoid them if you have a seafood allergy. Throw away any mussels that are open before cooking and any that stay closed after.

ingredients.nom: fresh ginger, cut into thin matchsticks
stalks of spring onion, cut into lengths

etapes.texte: In a large pot, gently fry the garlic ({ail}) and ginger ({gingembre}) in the oil ({huile}).
Add the mussels ({moules}) and water ({eau}), cover and shake the pot from time to time until they open.
Add the spring onion ({cebette}) and pepper ({poivre}), stir and serve with the juice.

notes: Serve with rice to make the most of the juice.

fiches.titre: Squash and carrot congee with ginger
fiches.contexte: Warm and light, to support the Spleen and settle nausea.

principe.fr: Strengthen the Spleen, harmonize the Stomach

ingredients.note: In a rice cooker, fill up to the Porridge line of the inner pot instead.

ingredients.nom: thin slices of fresh ginger, skin on
stalks of spring onion, finely sliced

etapes.texte: Rinse the rice ({riz}) 2 or 3 times, until the water runs almost clear.
Put the rice, water ({eau}) and ginger ({gingembre}) in a large pot. Bring to a boil, then turn the heat down low and leave the lid ajar. Stir from time to time.
Add the carrots ({carotte}) and squash ({courge}). Let it simmer until the rice grains burst and turn creamy. Add a little hot water if it gets too thick.
Add salt ({sel}). Beat the eggs ({oeuf}) and pour them in a thin stream while stirring, until they set into cooked ribbons.
Sprinkle with spring onion ({cebette}) and eat warm.

variantes.nom: In a rice cooker or multicooker

etapes.texte: Rinse the rice ({riz}) in a strainer, 2 or 3 times.

Put the rice, carrots ({carotte}), squash ({courge}) and ginger ({gingembre}) in the inner pot. Add water up to the Porridge or Congee line. If there's no line, use about 8 times the volume of the rice.
Start the Porridge, Congee or Soup program. If there isn't one, use Simmer or Slow Cook. Don't open the lid while it cooks.
Add salt ({sel}). Beat the eggs ({oeuf}) and pour them in a thin stream into the piping-hot congee, stirring with a non-metal spatula.
Sprinkle with spring onion ({cebette}). Keep leftovers in the fridge rather than on Keep Warm all night.

notes: Metal utensils damage nonstick inner pots.
To reheat a portion, add a little water, and add the egg at the last minute.
You can swap the squash for peeled chestnuts.

fiches.titre: Millet, sweet potato and jujube congee
fiches.contexte: Millet and sweet potato strengthen the Spleen, and jujubes tonify Qi and Blood. Ideal for breakfast when tiredness takes over.

etapes.texte: Rinse the millet ({millet}) in a fine strainer.
Bring the water ({eau}) to a boil with the jujubes ({dattes}) and ginger ({gingembre}). Pour in the millet and turn the heat down.
Add the sweet potato ({patate}). Let it simmer, stirring often, until the millet is very soft.
Remove the jujube pits, add a little salt ({sel}) and serve warm.

variantes.nom: In a rice cooker or multicooker

etapes.texte: Rinse the millet ({millet}), then put it in the inner pot with the sweet potato ({patate}), jujubes ({dattes}) and ginger ({gingembre}). Add water up to the Porridge line.
Porridge, Congee or Soup program (otherwise Simmer).
Remove the jujube pits and add a little salt ({sel}).

notes: You'll find millet in organic food stores and Asian grocery stores.
If you can't find jujubes (Chinese red dates), use regular dates: they're sweeter, so use fewer.

fiches.titre: Chinese yam congee
fiches.contexte: Chinese yam (shan yao) gently tonifies the Spleen, Lung and Kidney without being heating.

principe.fr: Tonify the Spleen, Lung and Kidney

ingredients.nom: fresh Chinese yam (shan yao), peeled and diced
ingredients.note: Peel it wearing gloves: its sap makes your skin itch. Or use 30 g of dried shan yao, soaked for 1 h.

etapes.texte: Rinse the rice ({riz}), bring it to a boil in the water ({eau}), then let it simmer with the lid ajar.
Add the yam ({igname}) and jujubes ({dattes}). Keep cooking, stirring now and then.
Add the goji berries ({goji}) for the last few minutes, add salt ({sel}) and serve.

variantes.nom: In a rice cooker or multicooker

etapes.texte: Put the rinsed rice ({riz}), yam ({igname}) and jujubes ({dattes}) in the inner pot. Add water up to the Porridge line.
Porridge, Congee or Soup program.
Add the goji berries ({goji}), leave for 5 minutes on Keep Warm, then add salt ({sel}).

notes: You'll find fresh Chinese yam in Asian grocery stores (a long, beige, hairy root), or dried as white slices.

fiches.titre: Chicken broth with astragalus and jujubes
fiches.contexte: Astragalus (Huang Qi) strengthens Qi and your body's barrier against cold. Ideal for preventing colds when you sweat at the slightest effort.

principe.fr: Tonify Qi, strengthen the body's surface

fiches.precautions: Not during a cold or a fever: astragalus “closes” the surface and would keep the illness trapped inside.

etapes.texte: Drop the chicken ({poulet}) into boiling water, then rinse it.
Put the chicken, astragalus ({huangqi}), jujubes ({dattes}) and ginger ({gingembre}) in the cold water ({eau}). Bring to a boil, skim off the foam, then let it simmer, covered.
Add the carrots ({carotte}) and keep cooking gently.
Remove the astragalus slices, add salt ({sel}) and serve the broth with the meat.
Drop the chicken ({poulet}) into boiling water, then rinse it.
Put all the ingredients except the salt in the inner pot, with the water ({eau}), without going over the max line.
Soup or Simmer program.
Remove the astragalus and add salt ({sel}).
Drop the chicken ({poulet}) into boiling water, then rinse it.
Put all the ingredients except the salt in the pressure cooker, filling it no more than two-thirds full. Close the lid and start timing once it starts to hiss.
Let the pressure drop on its own, remove the astragalus and add salt ({sel}).

notes: The astragalus slices aren't meant to be eaten.
You'll find astragalus in Asian grocery stores and Chinese herbal shops.

fiches.titre: Congee with goji berries, jujubes and black sesame
fiches.contexte: Goji, jujubes and black sesame nourish the Blood and the Yin of the Liver and Kidney: good for your eyes, your hair and dry skin.

principe.fr: Nourish the Blood, the Liver and the Kidney

ingredients.nom: black sesame seeds, toasted and ground

etapes.texte: Dry-toast the sesame seeds ({sesame}) in a frying pan for 2 minutes, then grind them.
Rinse the rice ({riz}) and bring it to a boil in the water ({eau}) with the jujubes ({dattes}). Let it simmer with the lid ajar, stirring.
Add the goji berries ({goji}) and the sesame, and cook a few minutes more.
Sweeten with honey if you like ({miel}), once the bowl has cooled a little.

variantes.nom: In a rice cooker or multicooker

etapes.texte: Dry-toast the sesame seeds ({sesame}) for 2 minutes, then grind them.
Put the rinsed rice ({riz}) and jujubes ({dattes}) in the inner pot, with water up to the Porridge line. Porridge or Congee program.
Add the goji ({goji}) and the sesame, then leave 5 minutes on Keep Warm. Add the honey when serving ({miel}).

notes: Honey shouldn't be cooked: stir it into the bowl once it's warm, not hot.

fiches.titre: Spinach and egg soup with sesame
fiches.contexte: Spinach nourishes the Blood and moistens the intestines, and egg nourishes the Blood and Yin. A quick evening soup.
fiches.precautions: Spinach is cooling and loosens the bowels: go easy on it if your stools are very soft.

ingredients.nom: vegetable or chicken broth, or water

etapes.texte: Bring the broth ({bouillon}) to a simmer with the ginger ({gingembre}).
Add the spinach ({epinards}) and let it wilt.
Beat the eggs ({oeuf}) and pour them in a thin stream while stirring.
Add salt ({sel}), drizzle with sesame oil ({sesame}) and serve right away.

fiches.titre: Creamy beet and red lentil soup
fiches.contexte: Beet nourishes the Blood and gets it moving, and red lentils support the Spleen and provide iron.

principe.fr: Nourish the Blood and get it moving

etapes.texte: Gently fry the onion ({oignon}) and ginger ({gingembre}) in the oil ({huile}).
Add the beet ({betterave}), carrot ({carotte}), lentils ({lentilles}) and water ({eau}). Let it simmer, covered.
Remove the ginger, blend, add salt ({sel}) and adjust the thickness with a little water.
On the Sauté setting, gently fry the onion ({oignon}) and ginger ({gingembre}) in the oil ({huile}). If you don't have one, just add them in.
Add the beet ({betterave}), carrot ({carotte}), lentils ({lentilles}) and water ({eau}). Soup program.
Remove the ginger, blend and add salt ({sel}).

notes: Your urine and stools may turn pinkish after eating beet: that's normal.

fiches.titre: Longan and jujube tea
fiches.contexte: Longan nourishes Heart Blood and calms the mind. Drink it in the late afternoon when your sleep is light and your mind is restless.

principe.fr: Nourish the Heart, calm the mind

fiches.precautions: Avoid it if you have a lot of bloating or a thick coating on your tongue: longan is sweet and a little heavy.

etapes.texte: Put the longans ({longane}), jujubes ({dattes}) and water ({eau}) in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil, then let it simmer.
Add the goji ({goji}), let it steep off the heat, then drink it warm and eat the fruit.

fiches.titre: Lotus seed and jujube congee
fiches.contexte: Lotus seeds calm the Heart and strengthen the Spleen, and jujubes nourish the Blood. For insomnia, worry and a delicate digestion.

principe.fr: Nourish the Heart, strengthen the Spleen

ingredients.note: Keep the green germ if the tip of your tongue is red (it cools the Heart); otherwise remove it, as it's bitter.

etapes.texte: Drain the lotus seeds ({lotus}), put them in the water ({eau}) with the jujubes ({dattes}), bring to a boil and let it simmer.
Add the rinsed rice ({riz}) and keep cooking over low heat, lid ajar, stirring.
Remove the jujube pits and serve warm, plain or with a little honey.

variantes.nom: In a rice cooker or multicooker

etapes.texte: Put the drained lotus seeds ({lotus}), rinsed rice ({riz}) and jujubes ({dattes}) in the inner pot. Add water up to the Porridge line.
Porridge or Congee program.

notes: For congee that's ready when you wake up, use your cooker's delay timer.

fiches.titre: Steamed pears with almonds and honey
fiches.contexte: Pear moistens the Lung and soothes a dry cough, and almond helps Lung Qi descend. A dessert that works as a remedy.

principe.fr: Moisten the Lung, calm the cough

fiches.precautions: If your phlegm is white and abundant, choose the daikon soup instead: pear is cooling.

etapes.texte: Cut the tops off the pears ({poire}) and scoop out the core with a teaspoon. Fill with almonds ({amandes}), goji ({goji}) and honey ({miel}). Put the tops back on.
Set them in a bowl over a pot of simmering water, with the lid on.
Eat warm and drink the juice at the bottom of the bowl.
Cut the tops off the pears ({poire}), scoop out the core and fill with almonds ({amandes}), goji ({goji}) and honey ({miel}).
Put water in the inner pot as the manual says, and the pears in a bowl set in the steamer basket. Steam program.

fiches.titre: Snow fungus, lotus seed and goji soup
fiches.contexte: Snow fungus (white fungus, Bai Mu Er) nourishes the Yin of the Lung and Stomach. Lightly sweet, it's enjoyed like a warm dessert.

etapes.texte: Soak the snow fungus ({tremelle}) in lukewarm water until it swells up.
Cut off the hard yellow base, then tear the fungus into small pieces.
Put the snow fungus, lotus seeds ({lotus}), jujubes ({dattes}) and water ({eau}) in a pot. Let it simmer, covered, until the soup turns slightly jelly-like.
Add the goji ({goji}) and sugar ({sucre}), and cook a few minutes more.

variantes.nom: In a rice cooker or multicooker

etapes.texte: Soak the snow fungus ({tremelle}), cut off the hard base and tear it into pieces.
Put everything except the goji in the inner pot. Soup, Porridge or Simmer program.
Add the goji ({goji}), then leave 5 minutes on Keep Warm.

notes: You'll find dried snow fungus in Asian grocery stores (also labeled “white fungus” or “silver ear”).

fiches.titre: Black bean, walnut and black sesame congee
fiches.contexte: Black beans and black sesame nourish the Kidney and Yin, and walnuts gently warm the Kidney. A deeply nourishing dish to eat regularly for a weak lower back, your hair and your memory.

ingredients.nom: black sesame seeds, toasted and ground

etapes.texte: Drain the beans ({haricots}), cover them with the water ({eau}), bring to a boil and let them simmer.
Add the rinsed rice ({riz}) and keep cooking over low heat, stirring, until creamy.
Add the walnuts ({noix}) and sesame ({sesame}), then add salt ({sel}).

variantes.nom: In a rice cooker or multicooker

etapes.texte: Put the drained beans ({haricots}) and rinsed rice ({riz}) in the inner pot, with water up to the Porridge line.
Porridge, Beans or Simmer program, on the longest setting.
Add the walnuts ({noix}) and sesame ({sesame}), then add salt ({sel}).
Put the drained beans ({haricots}), rinsed rice ({riz}) and water ({eau}) in the pressure cooker. Start timing once it starts to hiss.
Let the pressure drop on its own, add the walnuts ({noix}) and sesame ({sesame}), then add salt ({sel}).

notes: In a pinch, a store-bought black soybean and Chinese yam powder stirred into hot water works along the same lines. Check for added sugar.

fiches.titre: Braised lamb with Chinese angelica and ginger
fiches.contexte: A classic winter recipe: lamb and ginger warm you up, and Chinese angelica (Dang Gui) nourishes the Blood and gets it moving. For feeling cold, painful periods eased by warmth, and fatigue with a pale complexion.
fiches.precautions: Avoid it if you have signs of heat (red tongue, thirst, night sweats) or heavy periods, and during pregnancy unless a practitioner says it's OK.

variantes.nom: In a cast-iron casserole pot or saucepan

etapes.texte: Drop the lamb ({agneau}) into boiling water, then rinse it.
Put in the lamb, angelica ({danggui}), ginger ({gingembre}), onion ({oignon}) and water ({eau}). Bring to a boil, skim off the foam, then let it simmer, covered.
Add the carrots ({carotte}) and keep cooking until the meat is meltingly tender.
Remove the angelica, then season with salt and pepper ({sel}).
Drop the lamb ({agneau}) into boiling water, then rinse it.
Put all the ingredients except the salt in the inner pot. Simmer or Stew program.
Remove the angelica, then season with salt and pepper ({sel}).
Drop the lamb ({agneau}) into boiling water, then rinse it.
Put all the ingredients except the salt in the pressure cooker. Start timing once it starts to hiss.
Let the pressure drop on its own, remove the angelica, then season with salt and pepper ({sel}).

notes: You'll find Chinese angelica in Asian grocery stores or Chinese herbal shops.
Without angelica, it's still a good warming ginger stew.

fiches.titre: Stir-fried shrimp with leeks and walnuts
fiches.contexte: Shrimp, leek and walnuts warm Kidney Yang. A quick dish for fatigue when you feel the cold easily and your lower back feels cold.
fiches.precautions: Avoid it if you're allergic to shellfish, if you have eczema or hives that react to seafood, or if you have signs of heat.

ingredients.nom: slices of ginger, cut into thin matchsticks

variantes.nom: In a frying pan or wok

etapes.texte: Dry-toast the walnuts ({noix}) in the pan, then set them aside.
Heat the oil ({huile}), fry the ginger ({gingembre}) for a few seconds, then the leek ({poireau}) until it softens.
Add the shrimp ({crevettes}) and sear them until they turn pink.
Add the soy sauce ({soja}) and the walnuts, stir and serve with rice.

fiches.titre: Ginger and cinnamon tea
fiches.contexte: To warm the center when cold takes over: cold belly, icy hands, periods eased by warmth.
fiches.precautions: Not if you have signs of heat (red tongue, thirst, night sweats, mouth ulcers), and not every day over a long period.

etapes.texte: Put the ginger ({gingembre}), cinnamon ({cannelle}) and water ({eau}) in a saucepan, bring to a boil, then let it simmer.
Sweeten if you like ({sucre}) and drink hot.

fiches.titre: Pearl barley and adzuki bean congee
fiches.contexte: Chinese pearl barley (Yi Yi Ren) and adzuki beans drain Dampness through the urine: for heaviness, swelling (edema), and oily or weeping skin.
fiches.precautions: Chinese pearl barley (Yi Yi Ren) is not recommended during pregnancy.

ingredients.nom: Chinese pearl barley (Job's tears, Yi Yi Ren)
ingredients.note: In Asian grocery stores, it's sold as “Job's tears”. Regular pearl barley works too.

etapes.texte: Put the rinsed barley ({orge}) and the drained adzuki beans ({azuki}) in the water ({eau}). Bring to a boil and let it simmer.
Add the rinsed rice ({riz}) and keep cooking over low heat, stirring.
Add a little salt ({sel}), or leave it plain for breakfast.

variantes.nom: In a rice cooker or multicooker

etapes.texte: Put the barley ({orge}), drained adzuki beans ({azuki}) and rice ({riz}) in the inner pot, with water up to the Porridge line.
Porridge, Beans or Simmer program, on the longest setting.
Put everything in the pressure cooker with the water ({eau}). Start timing once it starts to hiss.
Let the pressure drop on its own and add a little salt ({sel}).

fiches.titre: Daikon soup with ginger and tangerine peel
fiches.contexte: Daikon (white radish) makes Qi descend, transforms phlegm and gets digestion moving; tangerine peel dries Dampness.

ingredients.nom: dried tangerine peel (or the zest of an organic tangerine)
stalk of spring onion, finely sliced

etapes.texte: Put the daikon ({radis}), carrot ({carotte}), ginger ({gingembre}), tangerine peel ({mandarine}) and water ({eau}) in a pot. Bring to a boil, then let it simmer until the daikon turns translucent.
Add salt ({sel}) and sprinkle with spring onion ({cebette}).
Put everything except the salt and spring onion in the inner pot. Soup program.
Add salt ({sel}) and sprinkle with spring onion ({cebette}).

notes: You'll find daikon in Asian grocery stores, and often in the produce section of supermarkets.

fiches.titre: Tangerine peel and ginger tea
fiches.contexte: Tangerine peel (Chen Pi) gets Spleen Qi moving and dries Dampness: for sluggish digestion, bloating and white phlegm.

principe.py: Lǐ qì jiàn pí zào shī
principe.fr: Move Qi, strengthen the Spleen, dry Dampness

ingredients.nom: dried tangerine peel (or the zest of an organic tangerine)

etapes.texte: Put the peel ({mandarine}), ginger ({gingembre}) and water ({eau}) in a saucepan, bring to a boil, then let it simmer.
Drink warm, ideally after a meal.

notes: Dry organic tangerine peels yourself in the open air for a few days: the older they get, the better they are.

fiches.titre: Mung bean soup
fiches.contexte: Mung beans clear Heat and flush out toxins: for summer, thirst, skin that feels hot or red pimples.
fiches.precautions: Cooling: avoid it if you feel the cold easily and have soft stools and a cold belly.

ingredients.nom: whole green mung beans (not bean sprouts)

etapes.texte: Rinse the beans ({mungo}), bring them to a boil in the water ({eau}), then let it simmer. To clear Heat, drink some of this green broth right away.
For a more nourishing soup, keep going until the beans burst.
Sweeten lightly if you like ({sucre}). Drink it warm, or at room temperature in summer.

variantes.nom: In a rice cooker or multicooker

etapes.texte: Put the rinsed beans ({mungo}) and water ({eau}) in the inner pot. Soup or Porridge program.
Sweeten lightly if you like ({sucre}).

fiches.titre: Chrysanthemum and goji tea
fiches.contexte: Chrysanthemum clears the Liver and soothes red or tired eyes, and goji nourishes Liver Yin. Ideal after a day in front of screens.

principe.fr: Clear the Liver, brighten the eyes

fiches.precautions: A little cooling: go easy on it if you have a cold belly and soft stools.

variantes.nom: In a teapot or a bowl

etapes.texte: Pour the water ({eau}) over the flowers ({chrysantheme}) and goji ({goji}), cover and let it steep.
Drink warm; you can top up the same flowers with hot water once or twice.

fiches.titre: Stir-fried celery and tofu with ginger
fiches.contexte: Celery calms Liver Yang and clears Heat, and tofu nourishes Yin. A simple dish for headaches at the temples and irritability.

ingredients.nom: celery stalks, sliced on the diagonal
slices of ginger, cut into matchsticks

variantes.nom: In a frying pan or wok

etapes.texte: Brown the tofu ({tofu}) in the oil ({huile}) on all sides, then set it aside.
Fry the ginger ({gingembre}) for a few seconds, then the celery ({celeri}): it should stay a little crunchy.
Return the tofu to the pan and add the soy sauce ({soja}) and spring onion ({cebette}). Serve with rice.

fiches.titre: Rosebud and orange zest tea
fiches.contexte: Rosebud gets Liver Qi and Blood moving, and orange zest relaxes the belly: for stress, sighing and tension before your period.
fiches.precautions: During pregnancy or if your periods are very heavy, ask for advice first: rose gets the Blood moving.

variantes.nom: In a teapot or a bowl

etapes.texte: Pour the water ({eau}) over the rosebuds ({rose}) and zest ({orange}), cover and let it steep.
Drink warm, in a quiet moment.

fiches.titre: Spring onion and ginger tea
fiches.contexte: A traditional remedy for the first hours of a chill-type cold: spring onion whites and ginger make you sweat a little and drive out the cold.
fiches.precautions: Only at the very start, with chills and a clear runny nose. Not if you have a sore throat, a high fever or yellow phlegm.

ingredients.nom: spring onion whites with their roots, washed

etapes.texte: Bring the water ({eau}) to a boil with the spring onion ({cebette}) and ginger ({gingembre}), then simmer only very briefly: the active compounds are volatile.
Add the sugar ({sucre}), drink it piping hot and bundle up so you sweat a little.

fiches.titre: Mint and chrysanthemum tea
fiches.contexte: For the start of a heat-type cold: scratchy throat, a slight fever, stinging eyes.

variantes.nom: In a teapot or a bowl

etapes.texte: Pour the water ({eau}) over the mint ({menthe}) and chrysanthemum ({chrysantheme}), cover and let it steep.
Add the honey once it's warm ({miel}) and drink in small sips.

fiches.titre: Warm apple and pear compote with prunes
fiches.contexte: Cooked apple and pear moisten the intestines without chilling them, and prunes keep things moving. For constipation due to dryness.

principe.fr: Moisten the intestines, ease bowel movements

etapes.texte: Put the apples ({pomme}), pears ({poire}), prunes ({pruneaux}), cinnamon ({cannelle}) and water ({eau}) in a saucepan. Cover and let it cook down over low heat.
Mash roughly and eat warm, ideally in the morning.

symptomes.nom: Fatigue during or after cancer treatment
symptomes.syn: fatigue tiredness exhaustion asthenia cancer-related fatigue chemotherapy chemo radiotherapy radiation immunotherapy cancer
symptomes.alerte: Tell your care team about this fatigue: anemia or another side effect of the treatment can be corrected.

symptomes.syn: nausea chemo chemotherapy vomiting throwing up queasy feeling sick
symptomes.alerte: If you vomit several times a day or can no longer drink, contact your care team right away.

symptomes.nom: Dry mouth or small sores in the mouth after treatment
symptomes.syn: mucositis mouth sores mouth ulcers dry mouth saliva chemo radiotherapy radiation loss of taste
symptomes.alerte: If the pain stops you from eating or drinking, tell your care team.

symptomes.nom: Tingling or numbness in the hands and feet after chemotherapy
symptomes.syn: neuropathy peripheral neuropathy pins and needles tingling prickling numbness hands feet chemo oxaliplatin taxol paclitaxel
symptomes.alerte: Tell your oncologist about this tingling: the treatment can be adjusted. No hot-water bottle or moxa on an area with reduced feeling: risk of burns.

symptomes.nom: Hot flashes caused by hormone therapy
symptomes.syn: hormone therapy endocrine therapy tamoxifen aromatase inhibitor hot flashes hot flushes breast cancer prostate cancer
symptomes.alerte: Don't stop your hormone therapy without talking to your oncologist: there are solutions. No soy, red clover, hops or Chinese angelica (dang gui) supplements.

symptomes.nom: Red, dry or burning skin in the radiotherapy area
symptomes.syn: radiation dermatitis radiodermatitis radiation burn radiotherapy radiation red skin dry skin
symptomes.alerte: Don't put anything on the treated area without your radiotherapy team's approval, don't massage it, and keep it out of the sun.

symptomes.syn: thyroid hypothyroidism underactive thyroid hashimoto hashimoto's thyroiditis levothyroxine synthroid high TSH
symptomes.alerte: Keep taking your treatment and having your blood tests: these routines go alongside it, they don't replace it.
symptomes.rappel: Thyroid: no iodine or seaweed supplements without medical advice, and skip the wakame in the recipes.
symptomes.info: An autoimmune disease in which the thyroid slows down: fatigue, feeling the cold, weight gain, dry skin, constipation, low mood, hair loss. When the thyroid no longer makes enough hormone, treatment with thyroid hormone is usually taken for life, with regular TSH checks.
symptomes.mtc: Mainly a weakening of Spleen and Kidney Yang (cold, slowness, swelling), often with Dampness; in the early stages, Liver Qi Stagnation is common.

symptomes.syn: thyroid hyperthyroidism overactive thyroid graves graves' disease basedow goiter bulging eyes exophthalmos low TSH
symptomes.alerte: Hyperthyroidism must be treated by a doctor. If you are on antithyroid treatment, a fever or a sore throat means you need a blood test the same day. Call emergency services (15 or 112 in France) if you have a fever with a very fast heartbeat, severe agitation or confusion.
symptomes.rappel: Thyroid: no iodine or seaweed supplements without medical advice, and skip the wakame in the recipes.
symptomes.info: The thyroid goes into overdrive: palpitations, weight loss despite a good appetite, feeling hot, sweating, tremors, nervousness, restless sleep, sometimes bulging eyes. It is treated with medication, radioactive iodine or surgery.
symptomes.mtc: At first, Liver or Heart Fire; over time, a Yin Deficiency that lets heat rise (sweating, weight loss, palpitations).

symptomes.syn: hormones hormonal hormonal imbalance PCOS polycystic ovary syndrome polycystic ovaries progesterone estrogen prolactin low testosterone andropause male menopause
symptomes.alerte: Keep up your follow-up with your doctor, gynecologist or endocrinologist, and tell them about any herbal remedy or supplement.
symptomes.info: Polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS): long or absent cycles, acne, excess hair, weight gain. Falling hormone levels (menopause, andropause): hot flashes, fatigue, low libido. Marked premenstrual syndrome: tender breasts, irritability. High prolactin: disrupted periods, sometimes discharge from the breasts.
symptomes.mtc: PCOS: Dampness on a weak Spleen, with Liver Stagnation or weak Kidney Yang. Falling hormones: Kidney Yin and/or Yang Deficiency. Premenstrual syndrome: Liver Qi Stagnation.

symptomes.syn: parasite parasites worms pinworms threadworms tapeworm giardia amoebas anal itching itchy bottom
symptomes.alerte: A parasite infection is confirmed by a stool test (or a tape test for pinworms) and treated with medication: see your doctor or ask your pharmacist for advice, and treat the whole family if needed.
symptomes.info: Anal itching at night (pinworms, common in children), stomach pain, loose stools, bloating, fatigue, sometimes weight loss, especially after traveling. Wash your hands often and keep your nails short so you don't reinfect yourself.

tableaux.resume: The Heart lacks strength: palpitations on exertion, shortness of breath, tiredness, sweating easily.
tableaux.mecanisme: Heart Qi makes the heart beat and moves the Blood. When it weakens, your heart races on exertion and the slightest activity leaves you out of breath and sweating.
tableaux.consulter: Palpitations should be checked by a doctor (electrocardiogram), especially if they are new or frequent.

items.pourquoi: Opens the chest, regulates the Heart.
Tonifies the Qi of the chest.
Tonifies the Qi of the whole body.

tableaux.privilegier: Grains, jujubes, longans, lotus seeds, chicken, regular meals.
tableaux.eviter: Overwork, too much coffee, strenuous exertion.
conseils: Alternate activity with real breaks during the day.
tableaux.simple: Your heart lacks energy: it races at the slightest effort and you get out of breath quickly.

tableaux.resume: Blood no longer nourishes the mind: palpitations, trouble falling asleep, lots of dreams, poor memory.
causes: A weak Spleen that makes little Blood
tableaux.mecanisme: The mind (Shen) resides in the Heart Blood. Without enough Blood, it loses its anchor: you struggle to fall asleep, dream a lot, and your memory lets you down.

items.pourquoi: Yuan-Source point of the Heart: calms the mind, helps sleep.
Strengthens the Spleen, which makes Blood.

tableaux.privilegier: Jujubes, longans, goji berries, eggs, spinach, grains, lotus seeds.
tableaux.eviter: Screens in the evening, eating dinner too late, coffee in the afternoon.
conseils: Go to bed at the same time every night.
Longan and jujube tea in the late afternoon.
tableaux.simple: Your mind is no longer well nourished: light sleep, a racing heart, a failing memory, vague anxiety.

tableaux.resume: Yin no longer holds the Heart steady: palpitations, restlessness, waking at night, night sweats, dry mouth.
tableaux.mecanisme: Yin calms and cools the Heart. When it runs low, Deficiency Heat stirs the mind at night: waking up, sweating, a racing heart.

items.pourquoi: Nourishes Heart Yin, stops night sweats.

tableaux.privilegier: Snow fungus (white wood ear), lotus seeds, pear, tofu, eggs, sesame, millet.
tableaux.eviter: Coffee, alcohol, spices, intense exercise in the evening, late-night screens.
conseils: Cool, dark bedroom; light dinner.
tableaux.simple: Your heart overheats from exhaustion: restless nights, waking up sweaty, nervousness.

tableaux.resume: Heat agitates the Heart: restlessness, insomnia, ulcers on the tongue, thirst, dark urine.
causes: Too much coffee, alcohol, spicy food
tableaux.mecanisme: Fire rises to the Heart and to the tongue, its “sprout”: red tongue tip, mouth ulcers, a restless mind that can't find sleep.
tableaux.langue: Red, redder and swollen tip, sometimes ulcerated.
tableaux.privilegier: Mung beans, lotus seeds with their green germ, green vegetables, cooked cucumber.
tableaux.eviter: Coffee, alcohol, spices, screens in the evening, overwork.
tableaux.simple: Too much heat agitates the heart and mind: nervousness, sleepless nights, mouth ulcers.

tableaux.resume: Worry wears out the Spleen, which no longer makes enough Blood for the Heart: tiredness, rumination, insomnia, palpitations.
tableaux.mecanisme: Overthinking tires the Spleen, which makes less Blood. A poorly nourished Heart leaves the mind restless: you ruminate, sleep badly and tire quickly.

items.pourquoi: Calms the mind, harmonizes the Stomach.

tableaux.privilegier: Lotus seeds, longans, jujubes, millet, rice, sweet potato, chicken.
tableaux.eviter: Eating while working, skipping meals, too much sugar.
conseils: Write your worries down on paper before bed to set them aside.
tableaux.simple: Too much worry and fatigue: your mind never stops, you sleep badly, you digest badly.

tableaux.resume: Heart Fire is no longer tempered by Kidney Water: insomnia, palpitations, night sweats, weak lower back.
causes: Prolonged overwork and lack of sleep
tableaux.mecanisme: Kidney Water should rise to cool the Heart, and Heart Fire should descend to warm the Kidney. When this exchange breaks down, the top overheats (restlessness, insomnia) and the bottom weakens (lower back, tinnitus).

principe.fr: Restore the exchange between the Heart and Kidney

items.pourquoi: Brings down what rises, grounds you before sleep.

tableaux.eviter: Coffee, alcohol, spices, screens and intense exercise in the evening.

tableaux.simple: Your body is exhausted and your mind too active: sleepless nights, a racing heart, hot flashes.

tableaux.resume: Dry autumn air or indoor heating dries out the Lung: dry cough, dry throat and nose, dry skin, with no real heat.

tableaux.mecanisme: The Lung likes moisture. Dry air takes away its fluids: the cough turns dry, and the throat, nose and skin dry out. This is the stage before Yin Deficiency, without marked heat.

tableaux.simple: Dry air irritates your airways: dry cough, itchy throat and nose.

tableaux.resume: The Stomach lacks strength: little appetite, little sense of taste, discomfort in the pit of the stomach, tiredness especially in the morning.
tableaux.mecanisme: The Stomach receives food and “ripens” it. Without enough Qi, it doesn't take food in well: appetite and taste fade, and a dull discomfort sets in after meals.
tableaux.pouls: Empty, especially at the Stomach position (right wrist, middle position).
